items.disposition: Canonical disposition IDs map SVC-07 to B6 (Market Truth event-loop work), not raw retention. The parent shorthand SVC07/raw retention is covered under SVC-08/B7 below. Runtime owns B6; this report makes no independent certification of that unrelated clause.

Raw mkt.trades rows now age out after30days through an explicit maintenance-only immutable purge. Ordinary repository and SQL immutable mutations remain blocked. Whole protected UTC days survive across all instruments. Market owner separately replaced per-frame files with hourly fsynced journals and sealed Parquet manifests.
items.limitation: Hourly archive test pointer belongs to market owner; this storage run directly verifies PostgreSQL raw retention and partition relocation only. Retention is called after verified backup by runtime.

items.disposition: Exact deploy/read_only_role.sql now sets tank_agent default_transaction_read_only=on. Existing SELECT grants and FOR ROLE tank future-table privileges were exercised. New role login starts read-only; SQL SELECT works and writes fail.
items.limitation: Executed only on isolated PostgreSQL16 local trust cluster. No production credentials or deployment claim.

items.disposition: Unexpired RUNNING jobs recover to QUEUED even at their final attempt. A recovery_reclaim marker reuses the interrupted attempt slot rather than consuming another one; genuine failure after reclaim still reaches FAILED at the configured limit. Expired work remains EXPIRED. Recovery count/time are retained.

maintain_partitions() is independent of backup/retention. It provisions15 future UTC days, drains occupied historical DEFAULT days atomically, and is called independently by startup/background runtime. Partitioned writes preflight their actual requested day before insertion, preventing fresh historical spill.
items.limitation: Scheduler test is runtime-owner evidence pointer. Storage proof exercises the independent method with no backup configuration or file access.

items.disposition: Named domain tables now enforce real typed required values for new writes, domain/natural uniqueness, deferred foreign keys, enum checks, immutable SQL triggers and generated physical bigint sequence IDs. Migration020 adds every core §14 required-field check, with explicit evidence-backed unknown/scout exceptions; no implicit numericzero is inserted. Typed timestamp queries and compound indexes power range/latest APIs; record JSON preserves §2 nested structures and analysis details while SQL projections expose canonical typed query fields. Direct SQL incomplete event insertion is rejected.

legacy_truth.new_writes: Forward-only CHECK(column IS NOT NULL OR documented permitted uncertainty) constraints reject new invalid rows even though catalog convalidated=false. Required identity fields additionally use native NOT NULL.
legacy_truth.existing_rows: Historical incomplete records remain unchanged; the migration does not invent evidence, replace nulls with zero, or falsely mark those checks validated. Physical sequence defaults apply to new append records; old nullable legacy serial projections are retained.
legacy_truth.keys: The JSON-record interface retains a stable storage_key primary key, supplemented by required domain identity unique indexes and compound natural uniqueness. Partitioned key uniqueness includes time, as PostgreSQL requires.
legacy_truth.record_interface: Repository reads retain the original lossless §2 JSON record, rather than rewriting nested representations into flattened §14 names. Typed columns are enforced projections and SQL query/join fields; unrestricted third-party SQL writers that desynchronize document/projection are outside the supported write interface. Agent SQL roles are SELECT-only.
legacy_truth.not_claimed: No blanket certification that previously incomplete legacy rows satisfy every §14 requirement, and no claim that all legacy serial columns were backfilled.

items.disposition: Every UTC daily partition overlapping any MAJOR+ reaction window is preserved across all instruments, rather than retaining only matching token rows. Historical DEFAULT data is split into actual dated children first. Unprotected expired raw/normalized rows are removed; the unbounded DEFAULT partition is not declared permanently retained as a workaround.
items.limitation: PostgreSQL owner verification covers database capture. Runtime is responsible for matching whole-day policy in filesystem raw/archive retention.

items.disposition: iter_late_arrivals uses indexed actual normalized recorded_at arrival range independently of original received_ts and frozen inclusive semantic market cutoff; keyset pagination orders arrival/storage_key without a capped history load. Ten market families gain typed recorded_at/received_ts and partial availability/semantic/identity compound indexes. No extra per-trade change feed. iter_metadata returns selected checkpoint fields without returning nested Market Truth payloads.
items.limitation: Market producers own actual recorded_at stamping and semantic deduplication; runtime owns mapping affected persisted arrivals to automatic immutable reaction revisions. Legacy availability remains NULL and is excluded rather than backdated. Storage-level evidence alone does not certify the combined automatic revision pipeline.

upgrade_controls.behavior: Archive historical budget state; preserve legacy LLM_BUDGET notices but reject new ones.
Release only explicitly budget-paused queued work, retaining original TTL/schedule audit; suppress only pending deliveries referencing historical budget notices.

Expire pending retired PUBLISH_PARTIAL jobs. Repair only never-attempted known-bug reaction schedules with expiry before run_after; revive only if corrected checkpoint+6h window remains alive. Historical DONE and unrelated attempted/expired work remain unchanged.
Transaction-only relocation permission. Parent ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock protects copy/delete/attach; all columns copied verbatim, rowcounts checked, original legacy CHECK validation states retained.

remaining_acceptance: Combined final independent suite and final tree hash belong to parent/auditor.
Production role/Compose deployment, actual provider credentials, and72hour/14day unattended acceptance are not established by these tests.
